Unit: one representative genome per species; boxes show the median and quartiles, dots are genomes.

## Genome size and gene number

```{python}
fig("F03_genome_size_vs_genes", "Genome size against protein-coding gene number (log-log), coloured by phylum.", "70%")
fig("F02_gene_count", "Protein-coding genes per genome by phylum (log scale).")
```

Gene number scales with genome size within each lineage, but lineages differ in intercept (gene density, intron content and repeat content). Compaction and expansion are examined as hypotheses in the [atlas](https://github.com/stajichlab/BFD_dashboard/blob/main/docs/summary_atlas/H2b_compaction_extremes.md).

## Protein length and composition

```{python}
fig("F04_protein_length", "Mean protein length per genome by phylum.")
fig("F05b_gc", "Genome GC content by phylum.")
```

Mean protein length is sensitive to gene-model quality (partial and fused models), see the quality panel below and the [H1 quality page](https://github.com/stajichlab/BFD_dashboard/blob/main/docs/summary_atlas/H1_quality.md).
